messages:
Lina (People Ops): Quick draft of a blister‑fast manager onboarding blurb and a day‑7 close checklist. Copy/pasteable for Slack or Notion — please skim.

Lina (People Ops): ---
Manager quickstart (paste this):
Hi {{name}}, welcome to Redwood! Im {{manager}}. Quick plan:
Day 0: confirm Okta invite + MFA, accept device, open access form
Day 1: 09:00 intro (10m), 09:15 setup check (15m), 10:00 product context + tiny task (45m), end day 1 1:1 recap
Week 1: pair on first PR, meet People Ops (30m), join team syncs
Day‑7 manager close: confirm Console access green, first PR or doc merged, set 30/60/90 draft, schedule 30d feedback
Who to ask: IT @Sam (devices/Okta/VPN), DevEx @DevEx Bot (repo/CI), Security @sec-team (KMS), HR @Jordan (payroll/benefits/probation)
Links: access form https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-request, create ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa label:access-onboard
---

Avery (Eng Manager): Add a 15m oncall/infra orientation if role touches infra. Also suggest a one‑liner on how to escalate blocked access (who owns queue).

Sam (IT): Will automate Okta/device steps for Day 0. Access tickets auto-created when HR form uses #onboard.

Jordan (HR): Add "benefits enrollment window: first 30 days" and probation check at 30/60. People Ops intro included.

Lina (People Ops): Can someone own buddy roster? Need an Eng owner to post rota.

Avery (Eng Manager): I can run Eng buddy rota for next hires and post in #eng tomorrow.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled to publish Notion template in 48h.

DevEx Bot: Added repo access playbook link to the Notion draft.

Lina (People Ops): Great — I'll publish the Notion snippet and add a short Slack intro template managers can paste: "Please welcome {{name}} as {{role}}. Buddy: {{buddy}}. First week goals: ..."

(End thread)
